Messages.Author: Emmit Svenson
Messages.Body:
If a Lasombra puts Political Struggle on a Priscus who is subsequently
burned or sent to torpor, does the Lasombra gain a vote in the Prisci
sub-referendum?

Political Struggle
Cardtype: Action
Clan: Lasombra
+1 stealth action.
(D) Put this card on a ready vampire. The acting vampire may enter
combat with the vampire with this card as a +1 stealth (D) action. If
the vampire with this card is burned or sent into torpor, the acting
vampire gains X votes, where X is the number of non-contested votes
the vampire with this card has; burn this card afterward.

Messages.Author: Halcyan 2
Messages.Body:
>If a Lasombra puts Political Struggle on a Priscus who is subsequently
>burned or sent to torpor, does the Lasombra gain a vote in the Prisci
>sub-referendum?

No. Prisci are generally considered to have 0 votes in regards to cards that
depend on how many votes a vampire has. (Similar for Island of Yiaros).

Halcyan 2

>It only gives them an additional vote for that political action in which

I think he means that Power Structure lets you tap it during a political action
(not necessarily during a referendum). So if you take a political action, tap
power structure, and get blocked, does the extra vote count for Island of
Yiaros?

Halcyan 2

Messages.Author: LSJ
Messages.Body:
